Prefers to be called "Jack." Wife's name is Margaret — she goes by Maggie. Has a yellow lab named Biscuit. Son Derek lives in Austin, calls on Sundays. Daughter-in-law expecting first grandchild in September. Retired science teacher. Hard of hearing in right ear — speak clearly. Prefers morning calls before 11am. Under extra stress lately since a close neighbor passed away last month.
